integrity: Theoretical result supported by an explicit proof; a standard-library numerical script checks one concrete parameter family but is not exhaustive.
scientific_limitations: Deterministic Tilman two-species occupancy model with initially below-equilibrium superior population and strict coexistence. No stochastic, spatially explicit, or above-equilibrium superior-initial-state claims. The full Hastings (1980) text was unavailable; equivalent older transient analyses remain a literature risk.
title: Sharp transient-overshoot threshold in a two-species colonization hierarchy
